title: My Lab
description: Homelab server: power & cost, system, containers, storage.

links.title: Disk Health
links.tooltip: S.M.A.R.T. health for all three drives

list.name: tariff
list.label: Tariff ₹/kWh
list.description: BESCOM energy charge per unit (kWh). Fixed charges and tax are not included.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the server last booted.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: All 4 cores, busy share. Sparkline follows the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: RAM in use by programs (excludes reclaimable cache).

panels.title: CPU temp
panels.description: Hottest CPU sensor (package or any core).

panels.title: Load
panels.description: Runnable + waiting tasks. At or above 4 the 4 cores are saturated.

panels.title: SSD used
panels.description: Root filesystem on the NVMe SSD.

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Running Docker containers, as seen by cAdvisor.

panels.title: Exporters
panels.description: Prometheus scrape targets that are down. Details in the Health row at the bottom.

panels.title: Drawing now
panels.description: Estimated wall-socket draw of the whole server right now. CPU and RAM are measured by the processor's RAPL energy counters. SSD and HDDs are estimated from how busy each disk is; the board (chipset, NIC, fan) and power-adapter loss are fixed estimates. Model: /docker/monitoring/prometheus/rules/homelab-power.yml

panels.title: Today
panels.description: Energy used since midnight and what it costs at the tariff in the dropdown.

panels.title: This month
panels.description: Energy used since the 1st of this month. Metering started on 24 Sep 2026, so September 2026 is partial.

panels.title: Projected per month
panels.description: Last 7 days' average draw, run for an average month (730.5 h).

panels.title: Projected per year
panels.description: Last 7 days' average draw, run for a year (8,766 h).

panels.title: Power draw by component
panels.description: CPU and RAM are measured by the processor's RAPL energy counters. SSD and HDDs are estimated from how busy each disk is; the board (chipset, NIC, fan) and power-adapter loss are fixed estimates. Model: /docker/monitoring/prometheus/rules/homelab-power.yml

panels.title: Where the power goes
panels.description: Average over the dashboard time range, extended to a 730.5 h month at the tariff in the dropdown. CPU and RAM are measured by the processor's RAPL energy counters. SSD and HDDs are estimated from how busy each disk is; the board (chipset, NIC, fan) and power-adapter loss are fixed estimates. Model: /docker/monitoring/prometheus/rules/homelab-power.yml

panels.title: Units per day
panels.description: kWh per calendar day (IST), stacked by component. Today's bar is still filling. Metering started on 24 Sep 2026.

panels.title: CPU by type of work
panels.description: Share of all 4 cores. 'Waiting on disk' is iowait.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used + reclaimable cache + free = all 16 GB. Cache is handed back when programs need it.

panels.title: Temperatures
panels.description: CPU = hottest core. The Seagate USB drive does not report a temperature, so only the WD shows. More in the Disk Health dashboard.

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: 4 = all cores busy.

panels.title: Network ($nic)
panels.description: Download above the line, upload below it. Pick interfaces in the Network dropdown.

panels.title: CPU per container
panels.description: 100% = one full core (the box has 4). Pick containers in the Container dropdown.

panels.title: Memory per container
panels.description: Working set (what the kernel can't reclaim).

panels.title: Disks
panels.description: Free space per disk. Days until full uses the last 24 h trend; blank means the disk is not filling.

targets.expr: max by (mountpoint) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", mountpoint=~"/|/mnt/disk.*", mountpoint=~"$disk"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", mountpoint=~"/|/mnt/disk.*", mountpoint=~"$disk"})

max by (mountpoint) (100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", mountpoint=~"/|/mnt/disk.*", mountpoint=~"$disk"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", mountpoint=~"/|/mnt/disk.*", mountpoint=~"$disk"}))

max by (mountpoint) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", mountpoint=~"/|/mnt/disk.*", mountpoint=~"$disk"} / (-deriv(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", mountpoint=~"/|/mnt/disk.*", mountpoint=~"$disk"}[24h]) > 0) / 86400)

panels.title: Space used over time
panels.description: Used bytes per disk.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Reads above the line, writes below.

targets.expr: (sum by (device) (rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{job="node-exporter"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (device) group_left (mountpoint) label_replace(max by (device, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", mountpoint=~"/|/mnt/disk.*", mountpoint=~"$disk"}) * 0 + 1, "device", "$1$2", "device", "/dev/(?:(sd[a-z]+)[0-9]*|(nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+)p[0-9]+)")

(sum by (device) (rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="node-exporter"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (device) group_left (mountpoint) label_replace(max by (device, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", mountpoint=~"/|/mnt/disk.*", mountpoint=~"$disk"}) * 0 + 1, "device", "$1$2", "device", "/dev/(?:(sd[a-z]+)[0-9]*|(nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+)p[0-9]+)")

panels.title: Busy time
panels.description: Share of time each disk had I/O in flight. Also drives the disk power estimate.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (device) (rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{job="node-exporter"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (device) group_left (mountpoint) label_replace(max by (device, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", mountpoint=~"/|/mnt/disk.*", mountpoint=~"$disk"}) * 0 + 1, "device", "$1$2", "device", "/dev/(?:(sd[a-z]+)[0-9]*|(nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+)p[0-9]+)")

panels.title: Read latency
panels.description: Average time per read request.

targets.expr: (sum by (device) (rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{job="node-exporter"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (device) (rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{job="node-exporter"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (device) group_left (mountpoint) label_replace(max by (device, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", mountpoint=~"/|/mnt/disk.*", mountpoint=~"$disk"}) * 0 + 1, "device", "$1$2", "device", "/dev/(?:(sd[a-z]+)[0-9]*|(nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+)p[0-9]+)")

panels.title: Write latency
panels.description: Average time per write request.

targets.expr: (sum by (device) (rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{job="node-exporter"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (device) (rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{job="node-exporter"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (device) group_left (mountpoint) label_replace(max by (device, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", mountpoint=~"/|/mnt/disk.*", mountpoint=~"$disk"}) * 0 + 1, "device", "$1$2", "device", "/dev/(?:(sd[a-z]+)[0-9]*|(nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+)p[0-9]+)")

panels.title: Scrape targets
panels.description: Each Prometheus exporter: UP when its last scrape succeeded.
